name.es: Registro de cabilderos de la Legislatura de Florida

note.en: Floor vote: third reading. The staff analysis says the bill helps engineering and design firms: “The bill may have a positive economic impact on a professional firm shielded by sovereign immunity protections”. Donors listed are engineering and design firms, as their names and reported occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for this vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2024-271).
note.es: Votación en el pleno. El análisis del personal dice que el proyecto beneficia a firmas de ingeniería y diseño (cita en inglés): “The bill may have a positive economic impact on a professional firm shielded by sovereign immunity protections”. Los donantes que aparecen son firmas de ingeniería y diseño, según sus nombres y ocupaciones en los reportes de campaña; esto no afirma que pidieran el proyecto ni este voto. Las donaciones se muestran con las fechas registradas, incluso las posteriores al voto. El proyecto se convirtió en ley (Ch. 2024-271).
note.ht: Vòt nan sesyon plenyè. Analiz anplwaye a di pwojè a ede konpayi jeni ak konsepsyon (sitasyon an angle): “The bill may have a positive economic impact on a professional firm shielded by sovereign immunity protections”. Donatè ki parèt yo se konpayi jeni ak konsepsyon, jan non yo ak okipasyon yo parèt nan rapò kanpay yo; sa pa di yo te mande pwojè lwa a ni vòt sa a. Kado yo parèt ak dat yo anrejistre, menm sa ki vini apre vòt la. Pwojè a te tounen lwa (Ch. 2024-271).

note.en: Floor vote: passage. The staff analysis says the bill helps construction companies: “The bill may have a positive impact on construction industry professionals and companies due to increased information on completing a permit application timely.”. Donors listed are construction companies, as their names and reported occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for this vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2023-229).
note.es: Votación en el pleno. El análisis del personal dice que el proyecto beneficia a compañías de construcción (cita en inglés): “The bill may have a positive impact on construction industry professionals and companies due to increased information on completing a permit application timely.”. Los donantes que aparecen son compañías de construcción, según sus nombres y ocupaciones en los reportes de campaña; esto no afirma que pidieran el proyecto ni este voto. Las donaciones se muestran con las fechas registradas, incluso las posteriores al voto. El proyecto se convirtió en ley (Ch. 2023-229).
note.ht: Vòt nan sesyon plenyè. Analiz anplwaye a di pwojè a ede konpayi konstriksyon (sitasyon an angle): “The bill may have a positive impact on construction industry professionals and companies due to increased information on completing a permit application timely.”. Donatè ki parèt yo se konpayi konstriksyon, jan non yo ak okipasyon yo parèt nan rapò kanpay yo; sa pa di yo te mande pwojè lwa a ni vòt sa a. Kado yo parèt ak dat yo anrejistre, menm sa ki vini apre vòt la. Pwojè a te tounen lwa (Ch. 2023-229).
